LanguageData.MT_ContextScatterConfig: Mortar scatter reductions must be finite, non-negative, and below 100% at tier V.
LanguageData.MT_ContextFireControlIntro: Improves aiming and protects non-hostile faction pawns. Shown effects use the current turret and combat system. Aggressive mental states, spreading fire and collapses are excluded from protection.
LanguageData.MT_ContextMortarCE: Uses CE mortar ballistics, ammunition and observation-marker targeting. The displayed effects apply to this mounted head.
LanguageData.MT_ContextMortarCore: Fires physical shells using standard mortar ballistics. Head upgrades improve shell damage, penetration and scatter.
LanguageData.MT_ContextSupportCE: Reduces mortar aiming and recovery time, with nearby automatic loading through the CE ammunition backend.
LanguageData.MT_ContextSupportCore: Reduces mortar aiming and recovery time, speeds up shells, and loads nearby physical shells automatically.
LanguageData.MT_ContextPayload: Strengthens mortar shell damage and explosion radius.
LanguageData.MT_ContextFriendlyPawns: Protects non-hostile faction people, animals and mechanoids; aggressive mental states are excluded
LanguageData.MT_ContextFriendlyBuildings: Mortar shells also protect buildings owned by this turret's faction
LanguageData.MT_ContextSupportSupply: Automatically loads usable shells within {0:0.#} cells of the base footprint
